about: His & Hers episode scripts (comic series; episode 1 was the original "Golf Heist" video about a new driver). Panels from data/heist-panels.json. 'box' and 'to' are fractions of the panel picture (outside 0-1 = above/below a framed panel): where the bubble sits and whose mouth its tail points at. 'narr' is the caption box (shown, not spoken: no voiceover). Episodes 2-3 use nature-documentary wording; from episode 4 the captions are traditional golf TV commentary laid over everyday life at home. 'hook' opens the video and leads every caption; captions ask for a send or a tag (shares are the biggest reach signal). An episode only goes into the weekly plan once all its panel pictures are in the repo.

episodes.title: The Golf Balls

panels.narr: Night falls. And the male golfer emerges... clutching his precious hoard.
He has found the perfect nest. The sock drawer. No predator would ever think to look here.
But the female... is never far away.
And, as so often in nature... she takes the spoils.

say.text: I'll take a sleeve. I'm playing Saturday.

episodes.title: The Rangefinder

panels.narr: Midweek. A parcel arrives at the burrow... while the male is away, foraging.
The female studies her prize. She can sense it. A rangefinder.
The male returns to the nest. And finds it... empty.
Remarkable. She has found the distance.

episodes.title: The Receipt

panels.narr: He's tucked the receipt away in the left pocket. Very tidy. Textbook course management.
Oh dear. That's gone in the washing basket. He won't want to see this one.
Big moment, this. All the pressure's on him now.

say.text: A set of irons? For me? Lovely.

panels.narr: And she's taken it off the last. What a finish. You simply can't teach that.

say.text: Keep the receipt. In case they don't suit me.

Oh, he's caught that one heavy. That'll have woken the whole house.
Well, nobody saw that coming. She's been waiting at the turn.
And she's straight down the middle. Unbelievable scenes on the first tee.
